### 19 Aug — Gibraltar codifies prediction‑market licence regime
**What moved** - *Gibraltar introduces dedicated prediction‑market regulation.* On 13 July 2026, the jurisdiction published its Prediction Market Regulations 2026 (Legal Notice 176 of 2026), creating the world’s first standalone rulebook for prediction markets.
